The '''battle''' of [[Vanguard Station]] was a result of the attacks of the former [[Cipher Agent]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Korven]], along with forces formerly of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], on [[Eternal Alliance]] targets.<ref name="FRAC" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Alliance responded by launching an attack on their base of operations on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. During the struggle, Korven was killed and her forces were defeated by the Alliance's [[Alliance Commander|leader]].<ref name="FRAC" />
